Anonymized zscloud-style series list

Mirrors the zscloud viewer thumbnails: rows are li.ui-draggable inside a scrolling div.StudyList#HLeftThumnail, each with div.thumnailClass > a > i.countClass and an id in the shape of a DICOM SeriesInstanceUID (all values fictional). The 2nd row carries an extra select class token (selected state). Out-of-container li.ui-draggable nodes — the patient-header / examination LI of the real page — live under a different parent and must be excluded by container scoping (they carry no "N幅" sequence text).
